anchoring: labels anchored at a past peak or fixed threshold give a decline already under way a mechanical head start; labels anchored at the current level (forward returns) do not, so the no-forecast drawdown score is expected near 0.5 there while pi still counts positives issued after the decline began
caveat: label conventions are reconstructed approximately on public data; no study result is replicated or evaluated

coudert_gex_2008.anchor: past peak (24-month max) incl. crisis months

gsy_2019.anchor: current level and later peaks (forward drawdown)

flags: pi(1/4) lower bound >= 0.5: most positives already in progress; drawdown AUC lower bound > 0.6: a no-forecast score looks skilled on this label
in_progress_rule: drawdown from the trailing W-period high >= f * theta (VIX: rise from the trailing 20-day low >= f * distance to 25)
quantities: pi(f) = share of positives already in progress (label-only lower bound on the detection share); AUC overall, on not-yet-in-progress positives and on in-progress positives

scores.drawdown: current drawdown from the trailing W-period high (no forecast content)
scores.realized_vol: 20-day (daily) or 12-month (monthly) standard deviation of log returns
scores.vix: for VIX labels: rise from the trailing 20-day low (progression) and the VIX level (proximity)
